rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for physical bleeding from an injury.

example.english: I cut my hand, and I still bleed from it.
example.traditional: 我隻手割親，而家仲流血。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 sau2 got3 can1 ji4 gaa1 zung6 lau4 hyut3

rows.note: Use this when a person or organization is losing money.

example.english: If business stays this bad, this shop will bleed money sooner or later.
example.traditional: 生意咁差，呢間舖頭遲早會蝕錢。
example.jyutping: saang1 ji3 gam3 caa1 ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 ci4 zou2 wui5 sik6 cin2

rows.note: Use this for vital resources, staff, or other valuable things steadily being lost.

example.english: The company has had many experienced employees bleed away over the past few years.
example.traditional: 呢幾年公司流失咗好多有經驗嘅員工。
example.jyutping: ni1 gei2 nin4 gung1 si1 lau4 sat1 zo2 hou2 do1 jau5 ging1 jim6 ge3 jyun4 gung1

rows.note: Use this when ink, dye, or another substance spreads into the surrounding material.

example.english: The ink got wet before it dried, and the words immediately began to bleed.
example.traditional: 水筆未乾就落水，啲字即刻暈開。
example.jyutping: seoi2 bat1 mei6 gon1 zau6 lok6 seoi2 di1 zi6 zik1 hak1 wan4 hoi1
